This November, the Rbanism community takes part in the [#30DayMapChallenge](https://30daymapchallenge.com/) for the third time. Every day of the month has its own theme (from *Points* and *Lines* to *Borgesian map* and *Pen & paper*), and participants make a map or visualization for it and share it on social media.

The Rbanism twist: all maps are made in R and published together with their code on our GitHub (see the [2024](https://github.com/Rbanism/30DayMapChallenge2024/) and [2025](https://github.com/Rbanism/30DayMapChallenge2025/) editions). There is no need to do all 30 days. Pick one or two themes that speak to you.

We kick off together on **October 23** at the Faculty of Architecture, TU Delft (Berlagezaal 1, also on MS Teams), with lunch, a lecture by [Mark Padgham](https://ropensci.org/author/mark-padgham/), the challenge kick-off and the Urbex book club.
